description: This Java class LogWrapper wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to facilitate logging and chaining log outputs in an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that implements LogNode for logging purposes by wrapping Android's Log utility, allowing log messages to be passed through a chain of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to which logs will be passed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional exception; then passes the log to the next node if present.
